commands.review_summary:
The PR replaces post-action route-level tab-list inference with backend-supplied target outcomes for Playwright and Chrome MCP paths, with focused tests and a live CDP proof harness.

PR surface: Source +375, Tests -46. Total +329 across 10 files.

Reproducibility: yes. for the wrong-tab bug on current main: the shared resolver's sole-tab fallback is directly source-reproducible. The remaining relay-continuity regression needs a real paired extension-relay CDP setup to observe the detach/reattach transition.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] A browser-owner decision is required on the relay public identity contract before a safe mechanical repair can be selected.

target.title: fix(browser): prove post-action target continuity before adopting a tab
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

After a browser navigation or action invalidates the selected raw target, route code retried tab lists and adopted replacements via heuristics: any sole remaining tab, a uniquely new post-action tab, or a uniquely URL-matching tab. None of those prove the acted-on page identity, so `/act` could return an unrelated tab's `targetId` and silently redirect the caller's next mutating action onto the wrong page.

## Why This Change Was Made

ClawSweeper's recommended path: make each backend return its operation-owned target outcome; remove route-level list inference entirely. Playwright navigate/act now read the acted-on page's raw target id via `Target.getTargetInfo` after the operation and return it on the result. Routes apply `resolveOperationTargetOutcome`: backend-reported id when present, otherwise the acted-on id (stale/closed) so callers require a fresh selection.

Removed heuristics:
- adopting a uniquely new post-action tab
- adopting a uniquely URL-matching tab (renderer swap inferred from lists)

Extension-relay profiles use the same Playwright `readPageTargetId` backend as persistent CDP. Chrome MCP existing-session uses tab-list membership via `readChromeMcpOperationTargetId` after navigate/act; close reports `operationTargetId: null`.

## User Impact

- **Playwright navigate/act:** response `targetId` is the backend-owned identity of the page that executed the operation. If the page closes, the acted-on id is returned (stale) and callers must re-select.
- **Extension-relay /navigate:** route applies `resolveOperationTargetOutcome` to `readPageTargetId` / `navigateViaPlaywright` outcomes (no list inference).
- **Chrome MCP existing-session /act:** route applies `resolveOperationTargetOutcome` to tab-list membership; stale acted-on id preserved when the tab is gone.
- **No wrong-tab routing:** unrelated tabs left open are never adopted from tab lists, URL cardinality, or sole-tab fallback.
- **Continuity preserved:** renderer swaps and action-triggered replacements still work when the backend reports the new raw target id (#25323 / #25326 / #46137).

## Evidence

### Live browser proof (real Chrome/CDP, route-level contracts)

Harness: `extensions/browser/scripts/proof-103785-target-continuity.test-harness.mts`

Run:

```
pnpm exec tsx extensions/browser/scripts/proof-103785-target-continuity.test-harness.mts
```

Redacted output:

```
=== Live-browser proof for #103785 (backend-owned page identity) ===

Scenario A: action closes acted-on tab A; unrelated tab B survives
  kept acted-on identity A: true
  adopted unrelated survivor B: false
  PASS: unrelated survivor B was NOT adopted.

Scenario B: renderer swap (page reattaches under new raw target at navigated url)
  adopted backend-reported reattached target: true
  PASS: renderer-swap continuity preserved.

Scenario C: extension-relay /navigate route (readPageTargetId post-navigate + route resolver)
  readPageTargetId (navigateViaPlaywright return contract)=FD1262FD… url=http://[redacted-host]/…
  /navigate route outcome target=FD1262FD… (acted-on=FD1262FD…)
  adopted backend-reported post-navigate target: true
  PASS: extension-relay route preserved backend-owned identity.

Scenario D: Chrome MCP existing-session /act route (tab-list membership + resolver)
  D1 tab still in list: kept acted-on identity when tab survives: true
  D2 tab gone after close: stale acted-on id preserved when tab is gone: true
  PASS: Chrome MCP route contract honored for survive + close.

=== ALL SCENARIOS PASSED ===
```

Scenarios C/D exercise the same production helpers the public routes call (`readPageTargetId`, `readChromeMcpOperationTargetId`, `resolveOperationTargetOutcome`) against real CDP tab lists. Full extension-relay `navigateViaPlaywright` over connectOverCDP requires the paired relay CDP endpoint (not available in this headless harness); renderer-swap continuity for Playwright backends is covered in Scenario B.

### Maintainer decision: relay-stable public handle

This PR wires extension-relay routes to Playwright page CDP identity (`readPageTargetId`). That matches the current relay transport (persistent Playwright over the loopback relay server). A separate relay-owned stable public handle that survives renderer detach before the Playwright `Page` reconnects would be a relay-bridge contract change (`relay-bridge.ts`), not a route-level inference fix. Recommend merging this no-inference behavior change now; track relay-stable handle design as a follow-up if `@steipete` wants a distinct public id through detach/reattach.

### Source and test changes

- `resolveOperationTargetOutcome` replaces list-inference resolver; no tab-list adoption.
- `readPageTargetId` exported from Playwright session; `navigateViaPlaywright` and `executeActViaPlaywright` return `targetId`.
- `readChromeMcpOperationTargetId` exported; Chrome MCP existing-session `/act` and close wire operation-owned outcomes.
- Extension-relay `/navigate` and Playwright `/act` paths wire backend outcomes via `resolveOperationTargetOutcome`.
- Tests updated; contract test for #46137 mocks backend `targetId` on act result; Chrome MCP membership regressions added.

Automated tests:

```
pnpm test:extension browser -- extensions/browser/src/browser/routes/agent.snapshot.test.ts extensions/browser/src/browser/server.agent-contract-core.test.ts
# Test Files 2 passed (2) | Tests 33 passed (33)
```

Extension package boundary typecheck: `extension package boundary check passed`.

Closes #103785
